description: This file defines the Online model class for the Opencart catalog system, responsible for managing online customer data by adding and cleaning up online records.

classes.name: Online
classes.description: A model class in Opencart for tracking online customers, capable of adding online customer info and cleaning up expired entries.

methods.name: addOnline
methods.description: Adds or updates an online customer record with IP, customer ID, URL, and referer; also cleans up old records based on expiry configuration.
